pair.human_continuation: "A vehicle driven by a terrorist from the Islamic Movement intended to strike a number of officers and carry out an attack," he said in a statement. "The officers responded and the terrorist was neutralised." The Northern Branch of the Islamic Movement was outlawed in November 2015, after the Israeli government accused it of fomenting a wave of knife, gun and vehicle-ramming attacks by Palestinians and Israeli Arabs that has killed at least 42 people in the past 16 months. The movement's Southern Branch, which recognises Israel's legitimacy and engages in national politics, has not been banned. Supt Rosenfeld said the officer who died was 34-year-old Sgt Maj Erez Levi.
